newsitem.title: USA: Marathon Texaco have commercial field.
newsitem.headline: Marathon Texaco have commercial field.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co said Wednesday successful appraisal of the Ewing Bank Block 963 discovery 135 miles south of New Orleans, La., has proven a commercial hydrocarbon accumulation with estimated reserves totaling 30 million barrels of oil equivalent.

The Ewing Bank Block 963 No. 2 well was directionally drilled from a surface location near the 963 No. 1 discovery well to a total depth of 15,600 feet, with oil pays encountered below 14,500 feet, Marathon said.
It has a 62.5 percent working interest in and operates this find. Texaco Inc holds a 37.5 percent working interest.

Well 963 No. 2 is in 1,760 feet of water, eight miles south of the Marathon-operated Ewing Bank 873 platform. The two existing wells and one additional development well will be completed sub-sea and tied back to Ewing 873 infrastructure.

Marathon said the third well is scheduled to be drilled early this year, and a 20,000 barrel per day initial production rate is expected when the field is scheduled to begin production in the first quarter of 1998.
Marathon Oil is a unit of USX-Marathon Group of USX Corp.
